# selfdoc layout

Inspect, check and migrate the per-repository directories selfdoc owns under .strictmetadata/

## layout dump

Print selfdoc's layout declaration: every directory it claims, whether the directory is handwritten or generated, whether the repository commits it, the manifest.toml that grants it and what that file must hold, and the paths it replaced

**Effect:** read_only

## layout validate

Check this repository's .strictmetadata/ directory: every directory carries a manifest.toml naming a tool this machine has, every directory selfdoc claims names selfdoc, a directory selfdoc owns starts with a dot exactly when it is generated, every directory selfdoc owns holds only what its side allows, nothing inside selfdoc's committed directories starts with a dot, and the derived ignore file is what selfdoc's declaration renders

**Effect:** read_only

## layout migrate

Move this repository off a layout before this one: every directory whose manifest.toml names selfdoc under stricttools/ (the layout before this one, whose generated directories already start with a dot) or under .stricttools/ (the layout before that, which named every directory bare) moves under .strictmetadata/, a generated one behind a dot (stricttools/docs -> .strictmetadata/docs, stricttools/.docs-state -> .strictmetadata/.docs-state, stricttools/.docs-cache -> .strictmetadata/.docs-cache, stricttools/posts -> .strictmetadata/posts, stricttools/vocabulary -> .strictmetadata/vocabulary, .stricttools/docs -> .strictmetadata/docs, .stricttools/docs-state -> .strictmetadata/.docs-state, .stricttools/docs-cache -> .strictmetadata/.docs-cache, .stricttools/posts -> .strictmetadata/posts, .stricttools/vocabulary -> .strictmetadata/vocabulary). It creates .strictmetadata/ (the manifests naming selfdoc are the grant), writes the derived ignore file for the new names, removes selfdoc's block from the previous root's .gitignore (the file and the previous root go when nothing else is left), rewrites every selfdoc.json value naming a moved path and every generated root file's header, writes .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml empty when the project has none, converts the manifests (.strictmetadata/.docs-state/manifest.json and .strictmetadata/.docs-state/post-manifest.json) from schema_version 1 to 2, which records the project's accepted words and rejected patterns from .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml, and commits. A repository already on .strictmetadata/ whose manifests are on schema_version 1 gets the manifest conversion alone, and one whose .strictmetadata/vocabulary/ carries no manifest.toml -- a repository moved from the older .selfdoc/ layout -- also gets that directory's grant and .strictmetadata/vocabulary/terms.toml empty when the project has none. Another tool's directories stay where they are. Refuses a repository already migrated with its manifests converted and its vocabulary directory granted, part-way through a move, holding selfdoc's directories under both previous roots, or never on a previous layout; --dry-run prints the plan and changes nothing

**Effect:** mutating
